description: Start one explicitly approved paid workflow run: pass the launch object of its quote unchanged (revision, content_digest, semantic_input_digest, quote_id and idempotency_key). Over REST, send the header Idempotency-Key equal to launch.idempotency_key; this tool sets it for you. Returns immediately with its captured receipt and native run_id; call get_run with its poll.arguments. Never auto-approve, auto-quote or invent a new key. If delivery is uncertain, recover with the original request and key; a new key can pay twice. Technical evidence is separate from human creative acceptance. Price: the price of the native run it starts, make_ugc or make_faceless, as its quote states it. Quote first with quote_workflow_plan; list_prices names every price.
name: run_workflow_plan
title: Start a paid workflow run
